business_problem: Best Buy uses generative AI to simulate a human-like shopping assistant, helping customers select thoughtful gifts by understanding their preferences. Meanwhile, summarization capabilities help the team condense thousands of product reviews into concise insights, improving customer trust and streamlining buying decisions.
solution_summary: Best Buy used Gemini platform to launch cost-efficient, real-time features — by integrating powerful large language models with in-house solutions — that enhance the online shopping experience and boost customer trust, satisfaction, and revenue. Best Buy uses generative AI to simulate a human-like shopping assistant, helping customers select thoughtful gifts by understanding their preferences. Meanwhile, summarization capabilities help the team condense thousands of product reviews into concise insights, improving customer trust and streamlining buying decisions. The team also uses Gemini to generate accurate answers to customers' product queries, based on product manuals and vendor-provided product information, to bridge the gap between digital and in-person experiences. Best Buy selected Google Cloud for its advanced AI capabilities and ease of implementation.
